QuestInfo.name: Through the Castle Gate
QuestInfo.1: #p3001000#wants you to go back to #b#m400000000##k and get #b#p3000001##k's help.

0.0: Ah, Kaiser. Did everything go well with the merchant crew? Things have proceeded smoothly here.
0.1: At the moment, the castle gates are locked with a seal which uses an ancient Nova ritual as its foundation. I can unlock the Nova ritual with my own knowledge, but I'll need some magic components. And time.
0.2: Go ask #b#p3000001##k, the high priest of #b#m400000000##k, for help so we can learn exactly how to remove the seal on the castle gate.\r\n#r#e(If you accept, you will automatically move to the relevant field.)\r\n

yes.0: #b#p3000001##k will explain the seal ritual to you. He should also go over the components we'll need.

no.0: If you have other things to take care of, please come back one you have done so.

1.0: Welcome to the sanctum of the Novas, Kaiser... \r\n#L0##bThanks. How's it going, #p3000001#?#l\n#k
1.1: I am well, as always. I heard the reason for your visit from #p3001000#. You are seeking information on Nova's seal ritual, is that right?\r\n#L0##bYeah. If we're going to smash the bad guys in the castle, we have to get in, first.#l\n#k
1.2: Indeed. Since you were never part of castle security, you would know nothing of its defenses. Even #p3001000#, who served as a guardian, only knows a little about the ritual.

yes.0: Please wait a moment. I'll tell you what you must do.
